# Entity types and information sources

The analysts resolve mentions to the following entity types.

Entity type: person (name, aliases, role)

Entity type: institution (name, address)

Entity type: location (name, address)

Entity type: vehicle (registration, make, colour)

Entity type: organization (name)

Entity type: online account (handle, platform)

The Trust receives information from these sources.

Source: Field reports (credibility 0.8)

Source: Community hotline (credibility 0.6)

Source: Social media monitoring (credibility 0.5)

Source: Police liaison bulletin (credibility 0.9)
